dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: I wonder if Lucelle's doing alright...

dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: *sigh* An old companion of mine. It could have lived free after I modified it, but then they took it away from me.

dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: There was no time to take anything back, because they then gave me a new workplace — the Fortress of Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: By the way, before Lucelle belonged to me, it was a Gardemek with the Gardes.

dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: It didn't resist when I modified it, so I took that as consent.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And that's how you landed a new job in jail.

dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: Even so, this job has some perks over my previous work at the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: My time in Meropide was more conducive to creativity, to be honest, given the lack of complicated processes and boring summary meetings.

dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: Even my daily meals were delivered by clockwork machines. Such an enviable situation! A shame, though, that the canteen manager refused to sell me that machine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not too sure about what you're saying here.

dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: No problem, just take it as me talking to myself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, such an innovative spirit should be praised.

dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: I doubt this is a compliment.

dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: No matter what, such an innovative spirit deserves praise.

dialogues.speaker: Hugues
dialogues.text: I have some materials of various sorts, please take some. See if you can come up with some innovative ideas.
